artifact.status_search_result: The normality of the family of meromorphic functions f on the unit disc satisfying f ≠ 0 and f^(ℓ) ≠ 1 was established by Gu Yongxing (1979), confirming the normal-family analogue of Hayman's alternative. The result is now classical and has been extended in many directions (shared values, multiplicity conditions, etc.).

status_evidence.title: On normal families of meromorphic functions
status_evidence.snippet: Gu showed that the family of meromorphic functions on D such that f ≠ 0, f^(n) ≠ 1 on D is normal.
status_evidence.claim: Gu Yongxing proved that the family in question is normal on the unit disc.

status_evidence.title: Normal families: New perspectives
status_evidence.snippet: Between the 1950s and 1980s, Hayman proposed conjectures concerning normality of meromorphic function families; Gu confirmed the corresponding normality criterion.
status_evidence.claim: The Hayman-type normality criterion (f≠0, f^(k)≠1 ⇒ normal) has been confirmed.
